# Diving

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-api-docs.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Dive logs, certifications, equipment, images and privacy settings.

Every method below hangs off a `Garmin` instance. See [Installation & setup](../../README.md#-installation--setup) for how to construct one:

```ts
import { GarminClient, Garmin, FileTokenStore } from "garminconnect-js";

const client = new GarminClient({ tokenStore: new FileTokenStore("./tokens") });
if (!(await client.loadTokens())) throw new Error("not connected to Garmin");
const garmin = new Garmin(client);
```

**10 methods.** The verification column says what has been
confirmed against a live Garmin account, not merely unit-tested.
[`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) carries the full evidence per method.

## getDiveGear

```ts
garmin.getDiveGear(gearId: string | number, currentUserDate: string): Promise<DiveGear | null>
```

```ts
const result = await garmin.getDiveGear(activityId, "currentUserDate");
```

**Returns**

`DiveGear`:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `desc` | `string | null` | no |
| `brand` | `string | null` | no |
| `model` | `string | null` | no |
| `gearField` | `{` | no |
| `type` | `DiveGearType` | yes |
| `fields` | `DiveObject | DiverCertificationFields` | yes |
| `notes` | `string | null` | no |
| `media` | `DiveMedia | null` | no |

Plus every field of `DiveGearSummary`.

explicit local YYYY-MM-DD date
